findings.title: Provider doc claims production caller is web_fetch, but web_fetch skips providers entirely
findings.description: src/fetch/provider.rs:18-22 states production caller is web_fetch, but WebFetchTool deliberately SKIPS invoking configured fetch providers (BT-D-R4-22). Only real production invocation is handle_test with hardcoded https://example.com.
findings.trigger: Future code trusting the doc and removing SSRF gate
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite doc to describe actual call surface

findings.title: Firecrawl scrape response ignores top-level success field, losing error details
findings.description: FirecrawlScrapeResponse only deserializes data. v2 envelope has success: bool, error: String. When 200 with success=false, caller gets misleading 'no markdown' error.
findings.suggested_fix: Add success: bool and error: Option<String> fields; reject success==false

findings.title: FetchRegistry::from_config never reads the enabled field
findings.description: cfg.enabled never consulted; Firecrawl auto-build hardcodes enabled=true. External gate in constructor/mod.rs:67-73 hides this but registry API contract broken.
findings.trigger: Any future caller invoking from_config without manual enabled check

findings.title: Operators cannot disable Firecrawl for fetch without disabling all of fetch
findings.description: Firecrawl auto-build hardcodes enabled=true. SearchBackendConfig has no enabled field. Operator cannot run search firecrawl + non-firecrawl fetch.
findings.trigger: Operator configures [search].backends.firecrawl but wants fetch without firecrawl
findings.suggested_fix: Thread enabled: cfg.enabled into synthetic FetchBackendConfig

findings.title: Misleading SSRF contract comment in firecrawl.rs
findings.description: Doc claims caller is WebFetchTool which has validated URL — but WebFetchTool doesn't invoke providers at all today.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace comment with accurate call surface description

findings.title: FetchProvider::is_available() is dead code; sync is_healthy() lies
findings.description: is_available() declared but never invoked. Both impls are degenerate (always true).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove from trait OR make it meaningful with cached health check

findings.title: Factory token-precedence comment suggests inline api_key works
findings.description: Doc reads like operator can put token in [fetch].backends.crawl4ai.api_key, which serializes nowhere
findings.suggested_fix: Update comment to reflect in-memory only

findings.title: Crawl4aiFetchProvider::from_backend silently drops explicit timeout=0
findings.description: unwrap_or(60) produces 60 for both None and Some(0)

findings.title: FirecrawlFetchProvider clones base_url and api_key unnecessarily
